cases.purpose: Every fixed and variable layout satisfies the registry arithmetic.
Truncation, overflow, hostile counts and max-plus-one fail before copying.
Noncanonical TLV order, duplicates, flags, reserved and trailing bytes reject.
Only suite 0x0001 exists in the Wave 1 public grammar.
Account, issuer, revocation and reset-control keys are pairwise distinct.
Subject, role and key proof substitutions do not cross-authorize.
Skipped, conflicting or post-revocation key transitions latch.
Device and router X25519 possession transcripts derive the same proof.
DXP role, subject, nonce, window and low-order mutations reject.
DRS restores every prefix head for zero through 1024 entries in O(N).
AccountTerminal is accepted as the final entry at any index one through 1024.
Only AccountTerminal may occupy the last reserved entry slot.
Exact key rotation may re-sign unchanged entries at revision plus one.
Capability creation restores current DRS and exact private DRT targets.
Terminal DRT compacts only after the reset cutoff and rollback horizon.
Account reset binds the exact old tuple and new account and reset key PoPs.
A newer external deployment head rejects a restored older local database.
Component kind, subject, DCP reference and schema are exact DCS rows.
Three distinct authorized receipts commit one global deployment-set CAS.
Two receipts do not satisfy the Byzantine quorum.
Conflicting same-sequence evidence latches globally.
Inclusion, consistency, prior head and durability proof corruption rejects.
Sensitive use stops without a fresh consistent three-witness lease.
DWL retains all four heads while DCL updates three and DWD rotates explicitly.
Membership and PMA/PMR closures verify independently then join exact roots.
Membership signers cannot authorize DNRC and PMA issuers cannot add members.
Reset, epoch, generation and protocol domains prevent root cross-feed.
DPC advances exactly from the canonical MRL2 anchor DPC hash.
Malformed DNS, private or mixed answers and second resolution reject.
Connected IP and TLS SPKI remain pinned to the verified DPC.
DPR and DPS bind both exact sender and recipient contacts.
Outer request ID, identities, operation, window and PRQ2 hash are exact.
A successful DPS wraps one exact 296-byte MRR2 and rejects MQR3.
Recovery uses inner exact replay then outer CAS without a new mutation.
Exact media, lengths and identity encoding reject ambiguous bodies.
A pre-CAS crash leaves the old active state and discards shadow safely.
Valid shadow and capsule complete the committed external head idempotently.
Missing or corrupt recovery state never rolls back an external head.
Capsule uses pin-core binding and validates bounds, AEAD and every row hash.
ArtifactRef hashes use one closed type-specific domain and reject cross-type aliases.
Every identity, tree, quorum and membership transcript uses exact widths and prefixes.
Receipts, proofs and leases beyond the DWD maximum tree size fail before crypto.
Successor DWD preserves retained heads and bootstraps replacements before voting.
MRLC restores both authority closures, current DRS and the composite LKG.
Catalog bytes, HMAC, DRS revision and composite selection mutations reject cold load.
HKDF-SHA-512 key, deterministic nonce and exact DRC metadata AD match vectors.
A derived nonce reused for changed metadata or ciphertext terminally latches the protector.
DRM bounds, canonical row hashes, Protocol restore, shadow and pin checks are ordered.
Every DPJ1 phase crash resumes exact bytes with zero repeated inner mutation.
Changed same-key request forks and equality at expiry terminally stales with zero inner callback.
Caps, max-plus-one reads, HMAC-first GC and corrupt quarantine prevent unsafe admission.
No destructive reset starts before witness and rollback tooling rehearsals are green.
Any registry, schema, vector or checker byte change invalidates the program manifest digest.
MRC1 row count, order, exact transition slice, duplicates and trailing bytes are closed.
A replacement witness starts only from the epoch, ID and maximum-tree-bound empty root.
TerminalStale preserves its exact source phase shape and never rewrites delivered rows.
Public, committed, HMAC, AEAD and fixed transcript record classes never cross-feed.
Zero IDs and one ID with different canonical issuance preimages fail in their exact scope.
Artifact entries, transition entries and router-member tuples use separate exact bounded counts.
Unchanged MIP1 carries one canonical bounded RIP2 that proves the exact MRL2 tuple against sealed MRLC.
RIP1, MRL1 and every non-RIP2 inner proof reject at DNP entry points before copying.
Sequence, reset, epoch, generation, member count, padded count, leaf index, root and tuple substitutions reject.
Only Registry one, XNode two, Shared three and MAUI four occur exactly once in sorted component tables.
DRT target, KRT/KRF scope and action, DXP role and DPC endpoint values reject zero, unknown and mismatched forms.
DNR and MRL2 masks match, capability-role combinations are valid and DPC NoNextPin exactly shapes the pin tuple.
DPA and DPD suite values and DPD and DPM capability masks are closed and role-gated.
Only the immutable external generation-zero ReleaseRoot pin can authorize the first exact KRT and DWD ancestry.
DRS and DRA reason codes are closed and AccountShutdown cannot cross-feed a nonterminal target.
Witness endpoint, durability, component mask, fork latches and reserved bytes accept only their exact Wave 1 values.
Outer MailboxPeerV2 and inner PRQ2 Store or Tombstone discriminators never share a parser namespace.
Every protected record binds exact domain, suite, unsigned length, N-minus-one header and omitted final HMAC field.
DXP salt, HKDF Extract, role-specific Expand info, proof and stored transcript hash have exact framing.
Unknown network, signer, key ID, RRM reference or duplicate external pin fails before callbacks.
Corrupt or rolled-back RRL recovers only from bounded exact root chain and a fresh matching witness lease.
Crashes around KRT and successor DWD commit expose either the old pair or the exact new pair, never a split.
ReleaseRoot predecessor must re-decode as exact genesis RRM or exact scoped zero-account KRT ancestry.
KRF effective time invalidates affected DWD and leases and prevents successor witness issuance.
Only the 120-byte mailbox MIP1 carrier accepts RIP2; the unrelated P04 MIP1 and RIP1 reject.
Every DWD successor advances the global witness epoch exactly once even when the witness set is unchanged.
Three durable terminal receipts precede the exact local RRL terminal CAS and recover its lost response.
DCN and DHL bind exact DWD, root generation and transition, terminal state and RRL authority head.
Genesis RRL and first DWD commit atomically and no durable RRL contains a zero latest DWD sentinel.
A sixty-fifth ReleaseRoot chain entry terminally fails and cannot trigger online compaction or manifest import.
KRT and successor DWD remain inactive until both effective and valid-from times under bounded skew.
A retained witness ID with a changed key is one replacement and cannot masquerade as retained cross-epoch continuity.
A successor replacing more than one witness, including all four, fails before activation or witness callbacks.
Subject policy is recomputed from the signed network, closed ACL and exact limits; zero or caller-selected hashes reject.
Draft 2020-12 equivalent validation rejects a top-level or case additional property in the vector skeleton.
Exact package inventory retains D-G APIs with zero Session or Native package.
